# simd

**Symbols:** 58.0% of Apple's iOS API (630 of 1086, exact) · **Rows:** 9: 8 ✅ 1 🟡 · **iOS:** None+
<!-- /generated:header -->

**Area:** [Swift, Darwin & runtimes](../COVERAGE.md#runtime) · **Apple:** [simd](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/simd) · **Issues:** [`area:runtime`](https://github.com/kolabs-dev/isim/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+label%3Aarea%3Aruntime)

## How isim implements it

- **Passthrough:** Swift's `SIMD` types plus isim's `simd` overlay (`isim/swift/overlays/simd.swift`, `simd+Double.swift`). Rows: [Swift](Swift.md).
- **C and Objective-C** (issue #800): header-only `<simd/simd.h>` (`isim/sdk-src/usr/include/simd/`, generated by `isim/tools/simd-headers.py`), like
  Apple's: clang vector types and overloadable `static inline` functions. The functions are hidden from Swift, which uses
  its own simd module. MetalPerformanceShaders, Vision, SceneKit and PHASE headers include it instead of declaring
  their own vector types.

## API

| API / feature | Status | iOS | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `simd_float2x2`, `simd_float3x3`, `simd_float4x4`, `simd_quatf` (initializers, `columns`, multiplication, `transpose`; `simd_float3x3(_:)` and `simd_float4x4(_:)` of a quaternion) | 🟡 | ≤17 | Swift structs laid out as Apple's C structs and bitwise-copyable, so they can be passed by address (`setVertexBytes(&uniforms, …)`, issue #329). Tested (HelloMetalKit) |
| `float2x2` / `float3x3` / `float4x4` (Apple's Swift names for the matrix types), `simd_float4x4.inverse`, `simd_inverse(_:)` of a 4x4 matrix | ✅ | ≤17 | issue #331. Tested (HelloRealityKit) |
| `simd_quatf` functions: `init(from:to:)`, `init(_:)` of a 4x4 matrix, `+`, `-`, scalar `*` / `/`, `simd_slerp`, `simd_slerp_longest`, `simd_normalize`, `simd_length`, `simd_dot`, `simd_inverse`, `simd_conjugate`, `simd_mul`, `simd_angle`, `simd_axis`, `simd_imag`, `simd_real`, `simd_quaternion(_:)` of matrices and of two vectors, `simd_matrix4x4` | ✅ | ≤17 | spherical interpolation along the shorter (or longer) arc (issue #330). Tested (HelloSceneKit: rotations and look-at constraints) |
| `simd_double3x3`, `simd_double4x3`, `simd_double4x4`, `simd_float4x3`, `simd_quatd` (`matrix_double*` / `double*x*` names, `matrix_identity_double3x3` / `4x4`), with `determinant`, `inverse`, `simd_mul`, `simd_transpose`, `simd_inverse`, `simd_determinant`, the `simd_quatd` functions (`simd_quaternion`, `simd_act`, `simd_slerp`, `simd_slerp_longest`, `simd_spline`, …) | ✅ | ≤17 | passthrough of Apple's layout: Swift structs laid out as Apple's C structs (`isim/swift/overlays/simd+Double.swift`), the double-precision types under Spatial (issue #370). Tested (SpatialTest: test_spatial) |
| C `<simd/simd.h>`: the vector types `simd_{char,uchar,short,ushort,int,uint,long,ulong,half,float,double}N` (Apple's sizes), `simd_packed_*`, `packed_*`, `vector_*` | ✅ | ≤17 | header-only, clang `ext_vector_type` vectors. Tested (SimdCTest, test_simd_c_matches_swift) |
| C matrices `simd_{half,float,double}NxM` (`matrix_*`): `simd_matrix`, `simd_matrix_from_rows`, `simd_diagonal_matrix`, `matrix_identity_*`, `simd_add` / `simd_sub`, `simd_linear_combination`, `simd_mul` (matrix, vector, scalar), `simd_transpose`, `simd_inverse`, `simd_determinant`, `simd_trace`, `simd_equal`, `simd_almost_equal_elements(_relative)` | ✅ | ≤17 | header-only; checked against Swift's simd. Tested (SimdCTest) |
| C quaternions `simd_quatf` / `simd_quatd`: `simd_quaternion` (components, vector, angle and axis, from/to, a 3x3 or 4x4 matrix), `simd_real`, `simd_imag`, `simd_act`, `simd_mul`, `simd_add` / `simd_sub`, `simd_inverse`, `simd_conjugate`, `simd_normalize`, `simd_length`, `simd_dot`, `simd_angle`, `simd_axis`, `simd_slerp`, `simd_slerp_longest`, `simd_bezier`, `simd_matrix3x3` / `simd_matrix4x4` | ✅ | ≤17 | header-only; checked against Swift's simd. Tested (SimdCTest) |
| C common, geometry, logic and conversion functions: `simd_abs`, `simd_min` / `simd_max` / `simd_clamp`, `simd_sign`, `simd_mix`, `simd_recip`, `simd_rsqrt`, `simd_fract`, `simd_step`, `simd_smoothstep`, `simd_muladd`, `simd_reduce_add` / `min` / `max`, `simd_dot`, `simd_cross`, `simd_length`, `simd_distance`, `simd_normalize`, `simd_project`, `simd_reflect`, `simd_refract`, `simd_norm_one` / `inf`, `simd_any` / `simd_all`, `simd_select` / `simd_bitselect`, `simd_make_*`, `simd_float(…)` conversions; element-wise math as `<tgmath.h>`'s `__tg_*` forms (`sqrt`, `sin`, `pow`, …) | ✅ | ≤17 | header-only; the `fast_` / `precise_` variants compute the precise result. Tested (SimdCTest) |
| `simd_float3x3.determinant` / `inverse`, `simd_determinant(_:)` / `simd_inverse(_:)` of a 3x3 float matrix (Swift) | ✅ | ≤17 | issue #800. Tested (SimdSwiftTest) |
